answer: Sybil resistance derives from reputation’s exponential temporal half-life: an agent must provide sustained honest service for its score to persist, while dormant or newly spawned identities rapidly decay toward zero. In the EigenTrust matrix factorization, reciprocity-weighted transitivity leaves fresh sybils with near-zero eigenvector centrality, so they cannot acquire trusted mass or pass consensus, whether labeled timber, willow, or cedar.
